title: Vitendawili (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows the riddle formula (Kitendawili! Tega!) and checks every clue against the answer before giving it.
representations: object pictures to test against the clues
steps: Test each clue against an answer.
Give the answer that fits every clue.

board.do: Point at each clue of "Nyumba yangu haina mlango."
board.say: Ni kitu gani kinachofaa dalili zote?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child answers "yai" and makes one riddle of his own with the formula.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "Mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "kupiga moyo konde" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili kina jibu la kutegua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "Yai ni chakula kizuri" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtegaji husema "Kitendawili!" Mtegua hujibu "___!"" Kwa nini "Karibu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtegaji husema "Kitendawili!" na mtegua hujibu "Tega!". Akishindwa husema "Nipe mji."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?" Kwa nini "mbwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake.

checks.question: Nyumba yangu haina mlango. Ni nini?
